name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 8 visits over 73 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 39 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2025-11-13, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.87 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
